summary: Plan A backend validation for Marathon-Prep programme fix. 21/21 pytest cases pass in test_iter75_plan_a_marathon.py covering: (1) Louis (louishallpt@gmail.com) profile handoff — main_goal_key='event', training_days_per_week=4, event_type_pref='marathon', primary_goal_id='marathon' all confirmed in Mongo; static verification that _apply_assessment_answers_to_profile is called AFTER coaching_dna.insert_one inside assessment_finalize; (2) _apply_days_cap_and_min_content A3 — 7 identical 45-min full-body strength workouts capped to 4, remaining 3 demoted to focus='recovery', title='Optional Recovery Walk', duration_min=20, optional=True, source_reason='days_per_week_cap', key long-run preserved through cap, no-op when cap missing; (3) A4 min-content flag — 45-min/1-ex strength card flagged with validation_status='incomplete_content'+needs_coach_review=True, endurance (focus='long_run') and recovery (focus='recovery') correctly exempt, 3+ exercises OK, sub-30-min strength cards OK; (4) validate_programme rules 7-11 — marathon+no-run → 'no running-focused sessions' error, target+2 sessions → 'exceeds target' error, target+1 → soft warning, >50% template → template-fallback warning, 5x identical titles → repeated-title warning, incomplete_content workouts → 'too few exercises for their duration' error; (5) endpoint smoke — backend responds, Louis login works, /api/programme/current and /api/coach/clients return non-5xx. No blocker issues found; Plan A changes verified working as designed.

critical_code_review_comments: _apply_days_cap_and_min_content correctly orders A3 (demote) BEFORE A4 (flag) — demoted 20-min recovery cards are then exempt from A4 via the LIGHT_FOCI check. Good.
Priority preservation in A3 uses stable sort key (key_session=0, endurance=1, strength=2, other=3) so long-runs / key sessions survive cap. Verified.
Rule 8 (weeks over target) groups by Monday of the ISO date via d.weekday(), matching the Mon-Sun window used in _apply_days_cap_and_min_content — consistent.
Rule 9 (endurance goal requires run) checks focus keywords AND title substring 'run' — covers both LLM-generated and template-source cases.
profile_snapshot in programme_context_for_llm now includes event_type_pref + primary_goal_id — visible to validator and LLM prompt. Good.
